key: PWM Timing and Waveform Generator (Three-phase, Two-level)
title: PWM Timing and Waveform Generator (Three-phase, Two-level)
text: 生成三相两电平门控时间信息，输入 2 路、输出 3 路；按 {Sampling mode} 指定波形采样方法；{PWM mode} 指定脉宽调制方法 Continuous PWM、{Continuous PWM} 指定连续脉宽调制方法 SVM: space vector、{Discontinuous PWM (DPWM)} 指定钳位方法 60 DPWM: 60 degree discontinuous、{Switching frequency (Hz)} 指定开关速率 1e3，按实例取值。
